inputs.clip_l: Photograph of a werewolf creature, full body, front view, A-pose, gray studio backdrop
inputs.t5xxl:
Full-length studio photograph of a practical-effects werewolf creature from a horror film, built by a special-effects workshop. Gaunt, emaciated body with visible ribs and stringy muscle, elongated arms, oversized clawed hands, digitigrade legs. Long narrow wolf muzzle, narrow pointed ears, yellow eyes, bared wet teeth. Matted, uneven charcoal-gray fur in wet clumps with patches of bare dark leathery skin, scars and dried mud. Standing straight-on facing the camera, centered, entire figure from ears to feet with margin. Neutral A-pose, arms held slightly away from the body, hands open, legs apart.
Shot on a full-frame camera, 85mm lens at f/8, large softbox key light from the front and soft fill, seamless light gray paper backdrop, faint contact shadow under the feet, sharp focus on fur texture and skin detail, realistic film photography.
